summary: Frontend-only testing for new /quem-somos and /orcamento pages plus logo/menu navigation. All 20+ acceptance criteria pass. Direct navigation, data-testids, form validation (empty submit -> error toast; valid submit -> success toast + form cleared), select options (Estado 12 + placeholder, Tipo obra 2 + placeholder), wildcard route -> /home, header logo click -> /home from any page, footer 'Quem somos' link, header/footer colors (#E30613 / #0000bf), floating buttons visible, mobile 390x844 no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390), no external http(s) anchor links on either page, and /home regression (first hero image is hero-56-anos.avif, no 'fraude' text) all confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer logo Engemix uses <a href='/home'> instead of react-router <Link>, causing a full page reload on click. Consider using Link for consistent SPA navigation (functionally works, so not blocking).

Cases links in /quem-somos and 'Conheça outros cases' button are href='#' placeholders - acceptable per requirements (no external links) but should eventually point to real destinations or be non-anchor elements.
Orçamento form submit is intentionally MOCKED (setTimeout 700ms) - flagged as expected per problem statement.
